2609.24838.title: MedRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Medical Agents via Clinically Aligned Self-Evolution
2609.24838.paper_summary: Medical agents increasingly combine general reasoning models with specialized clinical tools, yet their capabilities remain largely fixed by what clinicians and engineers design before deployment. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a different paradigm in which agents learn from their own failures and autonomously expand their capabilities, but directly applying RSI to medicine introduces fundamental safety challenges. We introduce MedRSI, the first recursive self-improvement framework for medicine, which continuously transforms diagnostic failures into new clinical capabilities through tool composition and task-specific model training. Inspired by clinical practice, MedRSI introduces two mechanisms for clinically aligned self-evolution. Clinical-cost-aware failure prioritization directs improvement toward errors according to their potential clinical consequences rather than frequency alone. Fast discovery with slow registration separates rapid capability invention from conservative adoption, allowing new tools to enter the persistent agent only after demonstrating sustained benefit across subsequent patient cohorts. Across public glaucoma and heart disease benchmarks and two private clinical tasks, MedRSI progressively develops segmentation, measurement, prediction, multimodal reasoning, and generative capabilities, surpasses manually engineered medical agents, and autonomously discovers solutions to clinical problems not anticipated by its original designers. Our results show that medical agents need not remain constrained by capabilities specified before deployment: with clinically grounded mechanisms governing what to improve and what to retain, they can continuously construct, validate, and accumulate new capabilities from diagnostic experience. Code is available at https://github.com/ImprintLab/MedRSI.
2609.24838.paper_summary_zh: 醫療代理越來越多地將通用推理模型與專業臨床工具結合起來，但它們的能力仍然主要受到臨床醫生和工程師在部署前設計的限制。遞歸自我改進（RSI）提供了一種不同的範式，讓代理從自身的失敗中學習並自主擴展其能力，但將RSI直接應用於醫學會引入根本的安全挑戰。我們介紹了MedRSI，這是醫學領域首個遞歸自我改進框架，它通過工具組合和任務特定模型訓練，持續將診斷失敗轉化為新的臨床能力。受到臨床實踐的啟發，MedRSI引入了兩種與臨床對齊的自我演化機制。臨床成本意識的失敗優先排序根據錯誤的潛在臨床後果而非僅僅是頻率來指導改進。快速發現與緩慢登記的區分將快速能力發明與保守採用分開，允許新工具在展示對隨後患者群體持續受益後才進入持久代理。通過公共青光眼和心臟病基準以及兩個私有臨床任務，MedRSI逐步發展分割、測量、預測、多模態推理和生成能力，超越手動工程的醫療代理，並自主發現原設計者未預見的臨床問題解決方案。我們的結果顯示，醫療代理不必受限於部署前指定的能力：通過臨床基礎的機制來管理改進和保留的內容，它們可以持續構建、驗證和累積來自診斷經驗的新能力。代碼可在 https://github.com/ImprintLab/MedRSI 獲得。
